title: CrystalMoonV2 and NotKansas: light-writing worlds to hyperbolic geometry
summary: Direct CrystalMoon implementation descendants, separated from the mathematical conjectures used as visual inspiration. Source-reported numerical tests; no independently repeated GPU benchmark.

nodes.claim: Extends CrystalMoon's periodic 64³ crystal field, density lens and inverted moon with coarse/fine crystal layers, feedback, traced moonlight deposited into growth, a membrane that mirrors world coordinates and refraction through transparent crystal.
nodes.survived: The implementation and source-reported 12/12 core tests demonstrate two-scale field behavior, exact membrane mapping and a controlled simulated ray guide: rod light 0.058 with straight tracing versus a capped 3.0 with bending. A reported headless GPU/CPU parity run has differences around 10^-8.
nodes.killed: Photons are geometric rays, not a wave-equation Kerr optical soliton. The membrane glues supplied world models, not a derived physical duality. The 4.9s to 2.2s headless SwiftShader frame timing is not an RTX 3060 measurement; no real-GPU frame-rate claim is supported.

nodes.claim: Direct CrystalMoonV2 extension with Poincaré-ball hyperbolic geodesics, a {4,3,5} mirrored cubic honeycomb and a separate animation of Gardam's 2021 Kaplansky nontrivial unit in the Hantzsche–Wendt group.
nodes.survived: The source reports three hyperbolic-geometric tests and six Gardam-unit checks. A separate viewer illustrates 21 by 21 group-algebra products landing on 121 elements, cancelling modulo 2 to an identity product in both orders. The underlying V2 crystal and camera still run.
nodes.killed: The crystal grows on a flat periodic 64³ grid and is mirrored into hyperbolic chambers, rather than evolved by a hyperbolic Laplace–Beltrami law. The renderer cuts off before the ideal boundary. The Coxeter group has torsion and is not one of the 2026 random-group zero-divisor counterexamples. Gardam's 2021 unit conjecture counterexample is not a zero-divisor counterexample or a new result; real-GPU timing is unmeasured.

edges.why: V2 explicitly retains CrystalMoon's field, clock, lens and moon engine while extending the implementation.
NotKansas explicitly retains the V2 engine, camera, membrane and lighting while replacing the moon's interior geometry and adding a separate Gardam viewer.

motifs.title: The evolving material changes its rays, then its viewing geometry
motifs.description: An evolving crystal affects viewing rays; V2 makes deposited ray intensity affect later growth; NotKansas changes interior viewing geometry but still mirrors a flat-grid evolving field.
